messages:
ravi: Alerts just popped up — lots of 429s for org_acero since ~03:18 UTC, volume spike ~10k/min. Not seeing errors from upstream. Any recent quota changes?
selma: seeing the same in dashboard. Per-org quota checks are failing with 'quota_exceeded' during auth step.
mike: pinging rate-limiter logs now. Quick grep shows `policy_applied: per_org` and a burst limit of `0` for that org_id. That seems wrong.
julie: we rolled out the new quota consolidation feature yesterday (PR #3421). It changed default burst handling to inherit env var `DEFAULT_BURST` if unset. Did we set that in prod?
oncall-bot: @channel incident created: INC-2025-0422 — elevated 429s affecting 1 enterprise customer. PagerDuty triggered.
selma: config check: the configmap `rate-limiter-config` in prod was missing `DEFAULT_BURST`. Looks like it fell back to `0`.
ops-sre: Ugh. The migration script assumed a default in code; but during deploy we switched to config-based default. Missed in the deploy checklist.
ravi: can someone patch the configmap to set DEFAULT_BURST=1000? That should immediately stop new rejects while we do a safer rollout.
mike: applying a hotpatch now: `kubectl -n inference patch cm rate-limiter-config -p '{"data":{"DEFAULT_BURST":"1000"}}'`
infra-bot: patch applied to configmap rate-limiter-config in namespace inference.
julie: restarting rate-limiter pods to pick up config. `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/rate-limiter`
ops-sre: pods restarted. Watching logs for reduced 429s.
selma: metrics show 429s dropping to baseline over the last 2 minutes. Good.
ravi: can we confirm no token reuse or stateful counter regression? Check redis counters for that org.
mike: checked redis: `GET quota:org:acero:burst` returns `950` (approx after rapid consumption), counters look sane.
julie: we should still revert the PR that changed default semantics until we have a migration. I'll open a revert and a postmortem.
ops-sre: creating incident timeline and customer notification draft for Acero account manager. Recommend explaining temporary throttling and that we restored burst to previous level.
selma: note for postmortem: missing deploy-time validation for critical config keys. Add a helm test that ensures DEFAULT_BURST exists in prod values.
ravi: agree. Also add an SLO alert that triggers when per-org 429 rate spikes above X for >2min, not just global 429s.
julie: created revert PR #3489 and added an immediate integration test. Planning to deploy to canary then prod in 20.
mike: monitoring shows stable now. I'll leave a follow-up to run retention job to recompute any migrated quota records.
ops-sre: incident updated: root cause = config drift during quota consolidation rollout; mitigation = config hotpatch + rollout revert; next steps = tests + migration + customer outreach.
ravi: thanks team. Please add timeline entries and assign postmortem owners. Closing loop in 24h. :thumbsup:
